reviewFlags.issue: The model launched in 2013 and no current manufacturer page or Israeli importer listing was found. Check whether it is still sold new in Israel.
The catalog gives an 8 cm woofer. Both review pages give 3-inch woofers (about 7.6 cm), so the catalog figure does not match the sources.

The manual found in the sources lists AC 120 V, 60 Hz, which is the North American version. The catalog says 110-240V 50/60Hz. Israel uses 230 V 50 Hz, so confirm the Israeli variant's voltage and plug before selling.
No source with the dimensions or weights of the units was found. The catalog values are unverified.
